root_cause.text: rtl8xxxu failed to initialize `hw->sta_data_size`, so mac80211 allocated too little space for the driver’s per-station private data and `rtl8xxxu_sta_add()` later wrote past `sta->drv_priv` in `struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE text states “The driver does not set hw->sta_data_size, which causes mac80211 to allocate insufficient space for driver private station data in __sta_info_alloc(). When rtl8xxxu_sta_add() accesses members of struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info through sta->drv_priv, this results in a slab-out-of-bounds write,” and the patch fixes it by adding `hw->sta_data_size = sizeof(struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info);` in `rtl8xxxu_probe()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Initialize the driver’s per-station private data size so station state can be allocated and managed correctly.
intent_record.what: In rtl8xxxu_probe(), a new assignment was added setting hw->sta_data_size to sizeof(struct rtl8xxxu_sta_info) immediately after hw->vif_data_size is initialized.
intent_record.how: This causes the driver to reserve and use per-station private data of the specified size when mac80211 creates station objects, enabling the RTL8xxxU driver to attach station-specific state correctly at runtime.
